explanation: Mathlib has no `IsOneCoverDense` (grep found nothing), so no declaration matches this statement about gluing a morphism out of a one-cover-dense subfunctor. I read the related lemma `Presieve.isSheafFor_singleton` in `Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Sites/IsSheafFor.lean`. The proof already uses it, but it only supplies an ingredient. The rest of the argument, about pullbacks and subfunctor compatibility, is substantial and is not a one- or two-line consequence of any single declaration.
